title: PixelBlades 2D
description: Light-weight spin-off pack from my other PixelBlades resource pack, without the 3D models.
body:
# PixelBlades 2D
![Preview of some tools from the pixelblades 2d resource pack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1b100297dfc51c819969815a122c2894bce6fa8_0.webp)

This is a Light-weight spin-off pack which is almost the exact same as my other [PixelBlades](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pixelblades) resource pack, but without the 3D models. Only the 2d item textures.
Aimed at those who liked the 2D item textures from the original one, but witout the excessive modeling.

I'll continue to update this pack along side the non 2D one.

 **Note:** 
 - This resource pack is still in early stages and models/textures are subject to change drastically


 **_Current Plans:_**
 - copper tools


### **Check out my other Resource packs**

[![PixelBlades](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/203dacdeff3225b7fe133c21ef85201bb0879eb0_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/project/pixelblades) [![PixelBladesPBR](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/22caf91efa87ee84c7155c85ece7f2759b78861c_0.webp)](https://modrinth.com/project/pixelblades-pbr-addon)

if you have any ideas you want to share or encounter any issues and want to report, you can **dm me on instagram: [@mr.payy](https://www.instagram.com/mr.payy/)**
